description:
## Finding

`pkix-path/tests/pkits_helper.rs:44`:

```rust
.unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("failed to read PKITS cert '{name}': {e} (path: {path:?})"));
```

The `{path:?}` format spec uses `Debug` formatting on a `PathBuf`, which produces output like `"/tmp/.../foo.crt"` (with quotes). `Display` would be more appropriate for a panic message intended for human reading.

Clippy: `unnecessary Debug formatting in panic! args`.

## Fix

```rust
.unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("failed to read PKITS cert '{name}': {e} (path: {})", path.display()));
```

## Priority

P4 — test-only ergonomic nit.
title: P4: unnecessary Debug formatting in panic! at pkix-path/tests/pkits_helper.rs:44
